An '''Imperial palace''', used by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Alexander Julstan IV|Julstan IV]], was located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
